name: OPEN BELOTE
description: Belote Découverte (Discovered/Open Belote) is a brilliant 2-player adaptation of the classic French game. It solves the issue of hidden information by dealing cards face up and face down on the table (similar to Schnapsen or German Whist variants), creating a game of perfect information and intense calculation. Players can see many of their opponent's potential moves, making it a chess-like duel of blocking and forcing.

content.text: Belote Découverte (Discovered/Open Belote) is a brilliant 2-player adaptation of the classic French game. It solves the issue of hidden information by dealing cards face up and face down on the table (similar to Schnapsen or German Whist variants), creating a game of perfect information and intense calculation. Players can see many of their opponent's potential moves, making it a chess-like duel of blocking and forcing.
A modern adaptation created to allow Belote enthusiasts to play when a full quartet is unavailable.
Two players only. Belote Découverte is the two-player open-cards variant: each player has a tableau of face-up and face-down cards plus a private hand; play is head-to-head with no partnerships.

Each player receives 16 cards, but not all in hand. 1. Deal 6 cards to each player FACE DOWN in a row. 2. Deal 6 cards FACE UP on top of the face-down cards. 3. Deal the remaining 4 cards to each player's HAND (concealed).

items.text: Standard 2-Player: Standard hand deal (6 cards each), draw pile. Less strategic than Découverte.
